verdicts.reason: A: The dark header has turned into a partial block in the top-left, and the headline is pushed right up under it. The orange divider is stranded alone at the far-right edge, and the body copy, 'Ships late June' and the legal line are tiny and hard to read, so a lot of the canvas is dead space. B: The dark bar is left as an empty floating rectangle, cut off from the logo, which now sits on the cream background. The divider floats between the two columns, and the headline, body copy and button crowd the canvas edges. Even so, its text is much larger and more readable and the two-column banner reads more clearly, so it is the less bad of the two.
